summary: [Slack] reversibility: chat.delete removes a message (bot can delete its own; deleting others needs broader scopes/admin). chat.update edits text/blocks. Deleted messages are NOT recoverable via API (no trash). Channel joins/leaves reversible; file uploads deletable. Exact scope/retention behavior UNVERIFIED in this pass.
followup: Verify delete scope requirements and retention behavior in current Slack docs at build time.
